flags.note: Flagged during the stage-5 extraction session as possibly representing the same underlying study as YCFJ2N9Z (preprint/published pair or otherwise closely related work) — both are included here independently, not merged; review manually before downstream use.

pipeline_steps.technique: Collection and detection of sharp-wave ripple (SPW-R) events from control-condition LFP recordings via the paper's supervised template-matching classifier

parameters.downsampling: 25 Hz wide-band signal downsampled to 1250 Hz
parameters.channel_selection: wire with greatest ripple-band (100-225 Hz) Gabor wavelet power
parameters.template: k-nearest-neighbor embedding on wavelet-derived SPW-R features, trained on hand-labeled ground truth from 4 separate mice
parameters.threshold: within-event ripple-band wavelet power >=12 MAD above session median
parameters.inclusion: immobility periods >=3 s only; visually verified

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction, ROI extraction, and neuropil-corrected ΔF/F calculation

parameters.preprocessing: SIMA software package used for initial motion correction, as previously described
parameters.roi_and_df_f: ROIs detected, fluorescence extracted, and neuropil-decontaminated ΔF/F calculated using Suite2p's built-in neuropil subtraction
parameters.curation: ROIs curated post-hoc via Suite2p's graphical interface to exclude non-somatic components

pipeline_steps.technique: Sharp-wave ripple (SWR) detection and spike sorting from E-Cannula recordings

parameters.swr_filtering: raw signal band-pass filtered 120-250 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, zero-phase forward-reverse), Hilbert transform to extract the ripple-band envelope
parameters.swr_threshold: candidate events flagged at 4.5 SD above the mean; start/end defined where the envelope returns to the mean; events with inter-event interval <10 ms merged, events <20 ms duration discarded
parameters.array_level_events: start/end times taken as the earliest/latest across all channels detecting the SWR, followed by manual curation to discard artifacts
parameters.spike_sorting: Kilosort2 run across all same-day recordings pooled together; manual curation in Phy checking waveforms and auto/cross-correlograms, with merge/split as needed; surviving clusters labeled multi-unit activity

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected SWR events and sorted multi-unit spike clusters

pipeline_steps.technique: Detection of synchronous calcium events (SCEs) and their co-occurrence with SWRs

parameters.sce_detection: deconvolved spikes thresholded at 3 SD per cell to define firing intervals; per-frame firing-cell count computed over adjacent 5-frame (~160 ms) windows; significance threshold from the 95th percentile of a 20x circular-shuffle null distribution
parameters.co_occurrence: SWR and SCE labeled co-occurring within a 200 ms window; significance from 1,000 random permutations of SWR timing

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: deconvolved calcium event trains and detected SWR events
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: SCE timestamps and SWR-SCE co-occurrence significance

pipeline_steps.technique: Clustering of SWR events by spatiotemporal features

parameters.features: per-channel ripple-band envelope time delays (via cross-correlation with the mean envelope across 16 channels; events discarded if fewer than 13 channels had a resolvable delay) and normalized per-channel ripple-band power, after discarding events with complex, non-single-peaked envelope shapes via dynamic time warping
parameters.clustering: K-means clustering with cluster count chosen by the within-cluster sum-of-squares 'elbow', repeated 10 times to select the best result
parameters.group_labeling: clusters further grouped into stationary-local, stationary-global, traveling-local, and traveling-global based on maximum channel-wise time delay (>5 ms = traveling) and number of active channels at >0.6 normalized power (>10 channels = global)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-channel ripple-band envelopes for detected SWR events
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: SWR spatiotemporal cluster assignments and cluster templates

pipeline_steps.technique: SVM-based decoding of SWR spatiotemporal cluster type from calcium activity

parameters.features: mean ΔF/F activity of each neuron in a [-150, +150] ms window around SWR onset
parameters.class_balancing: SWR events subsampled per cluster to match the smallest cluster's event count
parameters.feature_selection: recursive feature elimination in steps of 50 neurons to identify the most discriminative neurons and reduce overfitting
parameters.validation: 10-fold cross-validation; accuracy, precision, and recall compared against a random classifier
parameters.control_analyses: shuffled assembly labels (1,000x) and holding-vs-in-order neuron-subsampling controls to test dependence on assembly identity and spatial dispersion

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded SWR spatiotemporal cluster labels and decoding performance metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Detection of cell assemblies and their firing ratio under different SWR clusters

parameters.activity_binarization: ΔF/F in a [-150, +150] ms window around each SWR onset thresholded at 30% of each cell's mean ΔF/F to label active/silent
parameters.similarity: Jaccard similarity computed between each neuron pair to build a similarity matrix
parameters.null_and_threshold: surrogate similarity matrices from 200 shuffles of per-cell active-SWR identity; pairwise similarities below the resulting chance level set to zero
parameters.assembly_detection: community detection clustering on the thresholded similarity matrix; assemblies retained only if larger than the 99th percentile of surrogate cluster sizes
parameters.control: holding vs. in-order neuron-subsampling comparison (200 repeats) to assess the effect of assembly relationships on SWR decoding

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: identified cell assemblies and their per-SWR-cluster firing ratios

parameters.tests: two-tailed statistical tests, significance threshold p=0.05, error bars/shaded regions as ± SEM unless noted; test selection guided by inspecting data-distribution histograms

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium imaging preprocessing: whole-frame motion correction, manual ROI drawing, and neuropil-corrected ΔF/F extraction

parameters.neuropil_correction: six patches at 50% of ROI size

pipeline_steps.source_quote: motion corrected independently using a whole-frame cross-correlation algorithm

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning-curve and place-field analysis for interneurons and pyramidal cells (shuffle-based significance, Gaussian place-field fitting)
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial tuning curves, place fields, spatial information
pipeline_steps.source_quote: cell was considered to be a place cell if its spatial information

pipeline_steps.technique: Peri-SWR analysis: peri-SWR time histograms, SWR activity index, SWR duration/power/modulation by interneuron subtype

parameters.window: -3 s to +3 s around SWR onset

pipeline_steps.source_quote: cell's ΔF/F trace was z scored in a -3-s to +3-s window

pipeline_steps.technique: Generalized linear (ridge regression) model of calcium activity from behavioral predictors, plus general statistical hypothesis testing

parameters.predictors: velocity, position, reward, licking, with time-shifted copies
parameters.tests: one-way ANOVA with Tukey correction, paired/unpaired t-test, Mann-Whitney U

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: predictor significance per cell; statistical comparisons
pipeline_steps.source_quote: multivariate linear regression model to predict each cell's fluorescence
